edges.reason: initialize gates execution on msg.sender == initializer.
setIndex is restricted by the onlyManager modifier comparing _owner to msg.sender.
rebase is restricted by onlyStakingContract comparing msg.sender to stakingContract.
transfer debits _gonBalances of msg.sender.
transferFrom spends the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance of msg.sender.
increaseAllowance raises msg.sender allowance.
decreaseAllowance lowers msg.sender allowance.
renounceManagement is gated by onlyManager.
pushManagement is gated by onlyManager.
pullManagement accepts ownership based solely on msg.sender == _newOwner.
permit enforces block.timestamp <= deadline, a timestamp dependency.
_storeRebase logs block.timestamp, making recorded data timestamp dependent.
rebase emits block.timestamp inside LogSupply for the epoch record.
tx.origin is an unsafe substitute for msg.sender in authorization flows such as initialize.
stakingContract_ is stored into the stakingContract state variable.
_INDEX is converted through gonsForBalance and stored into INDEX.
profit_ drives the minted rebaseAmount computation.
epoch_ flows into _storeRebase and the emitted logs.
circulatingSupply_ is used as the divisor for the proportional rebase.
rebaseAmount is added into _totalSupply.
profit_ is converted to rebasePercent for the Rebase record.
epoch_ is written into the pushed Rebase struct.
previous circulating supply is stored as totalStakedBefore.
to is credited in _gonBalances during transfer.
value is multiplied by _gonsPerFragment to obtain gonValue.
gonValue is subtracted and added on the two gon balances.
from is the allowance and balance source in transferFrom.
to is the recipient credited in transferFrom.
value is deducted from allowance and converted to gons.
spender is the key of _allowedValue written by approve.
value is stored as the new allowance.
spender receives the increased allowance.
spender has its allowance decreased.
spender is the allowance target inside _approve.
owner is the allowance holder inside _approve.
owner is recovered from the signature and checked as signer.
deadline is compared against block.timestamp in permit.
spender receives the allowance set by permit.
who indexes _gonBalances in balanceOf.
initialize assigns the stakingContract state variable.
initialize zeroes the initializer address, disabling re-initialization.
initialize credits TOTAL_GONS to the staking contract in _gonBalances.
setIndex writes INDEX.
setIndex calls gonsForBalance to convert the input.
rebase reads circulatingSupply() for the proportional denominator.
rebase performs supply inflation arithmetic and caps against MAX_SUPPLY.
rebase recomputes _gonsPerFragment from the new total supply.
rebase calls _storeRebase to persist the epoch.
_storeRebase pushes a new Rebase struct into rebases.
_storeRebase reads index() for the stored record and event.
transfer multiplies value by _gonsPerFragment.
transfer mutates _gonBalances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom decrements the _allowedValue allowance.
transferFrom moves gon balances between from and to.
transferFrom calls gonsForBalance to size the debit.
approve writes _allowedValue.
increaseAllowance adds into _allowedValue.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from _allowedValue.
_approve writes _allowedValue and emits Approval.
permit performs ecrecover verification of the owner signature.
permit finalizes the allowance through _approve.
permit increments the owner nonce in _nonces.
nonces reads the counter from _nonces.
balanceOf reads _gonBalances.
balanceOf divides by _gonsPerFragment.
circulatingSupply subtracts the staking balance from _totalSupply.
circulatingSupply calls balanceOf(stakingContract).
circulatingSupply reads the stakingContract address.
index reads the INDEX state variable.
index converts through balanceForGons.
gonsForBalance multiplies by _gonsPerFragment.
balanceForGons divides by _gonsPerFragment.
manager returns _owner.
renounceManagement sets _owner to the zero address.
pushManagement stores the pending owner in _newOwner.
pullManagement authorizes solely on msg.sender equaling _newOwner.
pullManagement transfers ownership into _owner.
Low-level value call hands control to the recipient, which can re-enter token transfer paths.
Low-level value call can re-enter transferFrom before balance/allowance accounting settles.
delegatecall executes untrusted target code in this contract context, able to re-enter approval state.
rebase arithmetic writes the inflated value into _totalSupply, capped at MAX_SUPPLY.
ecrecover result is compared to owner to authorize the allowance change.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter exists only to configure the staking contract inside initialize.
Parameter is consumed by setIndex before being persisted as INDEX.
Profit input is used only within rebase and its _storeRebase call.
Epoch input is used only within rebase and its _storeRebase call.
Local caches the return of circulatingSupply() and serves as the rebase denominator.
Local holds the minted amount produced by the rebase arithmetic operation.
Recipient parameter is used only to credit the transfer destination.
Amount parameter is used only to size the transfer debit and credit.
Local stores the gon-converted amount for the transfer state updates.
Source parameter is used only inside transferFrom for allowance and balance debits.
Spender parameter is used only as the allowance mapping key in approve.
Owner parameter is used only for signature verification and allowance granting.
Deadline parameter is read only in the permit timestamp comparison.
Query account parameter is used only to index _gonBalances in balanceOf.
